dedupe_keys.name: from raw gps to gtfs a real world open dataset for bus travel time prediction

description: From Raw GPS to GTFS: A Real-World Open Dataset for Bus Travel Time Prediction is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Aigerim Mansurova, Aigerim Mussina (Astana IT University). The dataset introduces an open, high-resolution dataset of real-world bus operations in Astana, Kazakhstan, captured from GPS trajectories between July and September 2024. The data cover three high-frequency routes and have been processed into a GTFS format. Coverage: global (KZ); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
